integrity: Finite exhaustive checks support but do not substitute for the all-length matrix identity or blocking CLT. The work has self-review only, with no independent mathematical or computational validation.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet only; exactly one non-wrapping four-symbol window subject to an unrestricted permutation; no optimal-code-size claim. The general pointwise ball-size formula and mean are credited to the motivating paper. A previously unindexed equivalent of the evaluated population law cannot be ruled out.
title: Complete binary length-four substring-permutation ball-size law
